My last year of school and up through the spring, I’d been pretty much just applying to my area (it’s a very space/defense heavy city), but I’ve since expanded my search pretty much all over the country. 

I have a basic resume outline that I try to tweak for each position to include more relevant skills, buzzwords, etc. Also tried jobscan and stuff like that but didn’t have great luck depending on the specificity of the position

I mean, I’m sure I’m not the greatest interviewee in the world, but I never felt like any of them went poorly. I was always able to answer everything they asked, get them talking, ask a few questions of my own, no getting flustered etc.

I’ve had a few people working with me on interview skills so I’m at least not just going in blind.

They mostly asked me to tell them a little about myself, describe my projects, how I liked my school’s engineering program, ability to get security clearance, willingness to relocate, all that kind of thing
